Koruha chirps lightly in Ozgur dreams. She sings a soothing song. And the song tells the story of two brothers. Their bond moves to betrayal and yet the tone of the song stays sweet. And as it crescendos and falls they age a life time separate from one another by decades of offense. And then again the chorus repeats. Once again they are young. And the Ozgur sees them, his heart heavy for the future that they will see. And the song of Koruha which springs from that heaviness gives him kindness and compassion, service and hope. He sings Koruha's song and the brothers are moved. Forgiven. Forgotten. Freed from a destiny full of regrets.

They touch their finger to their temple and then lightly to the amulet. || "it remembers how it was I think"|| "It remembers how it was I think," the pieces slowly draw themselves together. No hint of crack or flaw remains.

*Goblins and enclosed spaces do not mix well.* Despite being dexterous, Leaf has been inside only three places before now (Museum for the fight, the Mason's temple and the Fat Friar a grand total of two times). In her first days here she was extremely on edge and clumsy, not used to hard metal under her feet. Leaf also doesn't have shoes, so her toe claws click against the metal and it makes her very comfortable and self conscious. If your character is an early riser they may have caught her attempting to file them down a few times. 

It's not all bad though. Each morning Leaf tends to her flower bed- as in on her first day here she dumped all the seeds from her pockets into her bed. After only a few days of Druidcraft her entire bed began to sprout grass and flowers of all kinds. Hopefully none of you have seasonal allergies...

In addition to this routine , every evening before bed, when she would usually be looking up at the stars with the Rooftopgang, she sits on her flower bed with her carved holy symbol in her lap, silently praying to the Wild Mother. Despite her unfamiliarity with it, the ocean cradling the ship brings her comfort, and she thanks Melora for each day they are allowed to pass peacefully. She attributes this to your uneventful passage so far, but who knows how long the peace will last.

Leaf's Platapusocalypse
*2nd-level Conjuration*

**Casting time:** 1 Action
**Range:** 500 feet
**Components:** V, S, M (A tuft of fur, an eggshell, and flower.)
**Duration:** 1 hour

You summon 2d8 platapus (CR 0)  that appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within range. A summoned creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. 
The summoned platapus are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which have their own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to then, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.

***At Higher Levels.*** When you cast this spell at 4th level or higher, the number of platapus summoned by 2d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.
